description: Status of a running PS2 game started with pcsx2_upscale_multiplier 8x, pcsx2_vr_mode stereoscopic and pcsx2_vr_depth 200%, from a host with ps2ResolutionLimits, recorded with the real LRPS2 at LRPS2_COMMIT and Jak and Daxter on an NVIDIA RTX 4080 SUPER (WGL, OpenGL 3.3 core). The host keeps VR off, so the frame is one picture wide and 8x fits: 1x to 8x are listed, 8x is active, and resolutionError is empty. Neither VR option is in options, which shows one of the 67 options LRPS2 listed; the rest are as LRPS2 gives them.
